review:
DJ Psycho is a 4x4 cluster slot where three or more touching symbols win and disappear. Transformed symbols gain a second value through Crossed Symbols, and the xKnob symbol turns into a wild and adds at least +1 to a global multiplier that becomes sticky during Psycho Spins.

The Break symbol shakes things up further. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 25,420x cap and a high 39.5% hit rate, so small wins come often while the global multiplier builds. The club setting fits the pace.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
